notes: Company is German (HQ Hannover); checked both the German storefront connox.de (hreflang x-default, channel 100001) and the English mirror connox.com (channel 100005) - both have a dedicated 'New' nav item: https://www.connox.de/design-neuheiten.html (h1 'Neu bei Connox', RSS feed title 'Connox Neuheiten' at /feed/104719.xml) and https://www.connox.com/new.html (h1 'New at Connox'). Category pages are 100% client-side React (static HTML is an empty '<section class="product-list-react">' mount point), so rendered with Playwright to get real counts and confirm this is a genuine newest-additions listing, not editorial: the underlying items API call is https://api.connox.io/v1/shop/<shopId>/items?view=search&limit=96&currencyCode=EUR&categoryId=104719&orderBy=newest&order=desc - an explicit 'sort by newest' query against a dedicated New category id (104719, identical id on both locales), confirming it genuinely represents recently-added catalogue items and is browsable/filterable like any other category PLP (color, main-category, category, brand, price, isOffer, percentageDiscount, inStock facets all present), not a marketing/lookbook page. On-page copy: 'All of the new products at a glance: Find the new additions to our assortment and magazine here' / 'From the most recent designs from international design fairs... to new items from already established brands - find all our new products here in one place!'. No sub-structure exposed (facets only, no genuine child New-Arrivals categories like 'Furniture New Arrivals'), so a single row. Reported using the German storefront (connox.de) as primary scope since it is this German company's native/default site (x-default); the English mirror shows an almost identical count (415 vs 411, same categoryId=104719) confirming it is the same listing concept with only minor regional-inventory variance, not a different page. Checked footer, sitemap and site search (English 'new arrivals'/German 'neu eingetroffen' style terms) - no additional New-Arrivals-type listing beyond this one was found.

rows.evidence: Rendered page text under h1 'Neu bei Connox': '411 Artikel sortiert nach:' and, at the end of the infinite-scroll product list, '48 von 411 Artikeln gesehen'; underlying API call https://api.connox.io/v1/shop/100001/items?view=search&limit=96&currencyCode=EUR&categoryId=104719&orderBy=newest&order=desc (English mirror connox.com/new.html shows the equivalent listing at 415 items via the same categoryId=104719&orderBy=newest query, shopId 100005)
